name: coopmanage-rwanda
description: Cooperative management platform for Rwandan cooperatives

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @coopmanage/backend" "npm run dev -w @coopmanage/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @coopmanage/shared && npm run build -w @coopmanage/backend && npm run build -w @coopmanage/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @coopmanage/shared && npm run typecheck -w @coopmanage/backend && npm run typecheck -w @coopmanage/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @coopmanage/shared && npm run test -w @coopmanage/backend && npm run test -w @coopmanage/frontend
scripts.db:purge-test-data: docker exec -i coopmanage-db psql -U coopmanage -d coopmanage -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < scripts/purge-test-data.sql
